entries.title: Interpreting frequency sign geometrically
entries.description: understand positive and negative frequency as opposite directions of rotation in the complex plane.

entries.title: Adding same-frequency cosines with phasors
entries.description: convert each cosine to a phasor, add the phasors, and retain the common $e^{j\omega t}$ factor.

entries.title: Forming the resultant phasor
entries.description: combine same-frequency terms into one equivalent phasor with net amplitude and phase.

entries.title: Converting a resultant phasor to a cosine
entries.description: rewrite the summed phasor in polar form as a single cosine in amplitude-phase form.

entries.title: Solving a full phasor addition problem
entries.description: carry out phasor conversion, complex-domain addition, and conversion back to one real sinusoid.
